mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_AVAILABLE' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_FROZEN' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS frozen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingSettle, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type IN ('MERCHANT_AVAILABLE', 'MERCHANT_FROZEN', 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE') THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS merchantCount FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN ledger_account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.owner_type = 'MERCHANT' AND a.owner_id = m.id AND a.account_type IN ('MERCHANT_AVAILABLE', 'MERCHANT_FROZEN', 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE') AND a.status = 1 LEFT JOIN ledger_balance b ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.account_id = a.id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(a.currency, m.default_currency) = #{currency}
SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabled FROM merchant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
